title: Frostbitten Demon in Ruins
description: A muscular purple demon with white frost-covered shoulders and head crouches in the center of a frozen, decaying scene. It is surrounded by intricate webs of ice, dark thorny vines, golden glowing runes, and tattered blue drapery in a dark, ruined environment.
prompt: A muscular purple-skinned demon with long claws and a frost-covered head crouches menacingly in a dark frozen ruin. Intricate webs of ice and thorny brown vines surround it, with glowing golden runes floating to the left. Tattered dark blue drapery hangs in the background, cold misty atmosphere, highly detailed dark fantasy scene.
